verdict.rationale: Retell's first-party docs say a single- or multi-prompt agent can connect to a remote MCP server and call that server's tools during a live voice or chat conversation, which is the core of this story. The separate Retell MCP server for Cursor and Claude is the server role and is not credited here. missing for 10: configuration and authentication details for the MCP connection, support for local (non-remote) MCP servers or for conversation-flow agents, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can plug MCP servers into this product so it can use their tools

citations.quote: Connect a Retell single- or multi-prompt agent to a remote MCP server so it can call the server's tools during a live voice or chat conversation.
Connect your single- or multi-prompt agent to a remote Model Context Protocol (MCP) server, and the agent can call that server's tools during a live call.
